# Google Developer Groups on Campus - REC (GDG REC)

> Official website and community developer portal for Google Developer Groups on Campus at Rajalakshmi Engineering College (REC), Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.

## About GDG on Campus REC
Google Developer Groups on Campus (GDG on Campus REC) is a student-led developer community supported by Google Developers. We help students bridge the gap between academic theory and industry practice through peer learning, real-world tech projects, hands-on workshops, and hackathons.

## Official Links
- Website: https://www.gdgrec.dev/
- Events & Workshops: https://www.gdgrec.dev/events
- About Us: https://www.gdgrec.dev/about-us
- Developer Resources: https://www.gdgrec.dev/resources
- Developer Tools: https://www.gdgrec.dev/tools
- Core Team: https://www.gdgrec.dev/team

## Events & Activities
GDG on Campus REC hosts tech activities including:
- Technical workshops on Web Development, Mobile (Flutter, Android), Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Cloud Computing, and UI/UX.
- Flagship college hackathons, ideathons, and coding competitions (e.g. Elysium and annual developer challenges).
- Google Cloud Study Jams and Android Study Jams.
- Open Source mentorship and developer certifications.

## Event URL Structure
- Event Directory: https://www.gdgrec.dev/events
- Event Details: https://www.gdgrec.dev/events/{event-slug} (e.g., https://www.gdgrec.dev/events/elysium)
- Event Registration Form: https://www.gdgrec.dev/events/{event-slug}/form
